messages:
rachel: customer AcmeMedia opened a quota request — wants a 5x increase on /v1/embeddings for 48h (launch). Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/4982

maya: can you paste the org_id + user_id? any other accounts from same billing?

rachel: org_id: org_8c9f3a user_id: user_3b2d7c - request form pasted below and logs attached. shortlink to logs: https://redwoo.d/s/4982
```
{ 
  "reason": "product_launch",
  "duration": "48h",
  "requested_multiplier": 5,
  "endpoints": ["/v1/embeddings"]
}
```

ops-bot: quick-scan results: token_rate=2200/s (default=400/s) ; new_account_age=3d ; payment_verified=true ; chargebacks=0 ; heuristic_score=0.46 (medium) :eyes:

samir: flagging for manual abuse/fraud review. @nina can you take the deep scan? do not approve full 5x until we have verification. propose temp cap 800/s so customer can continue onboarding.

nina: on it. TO-RUN: card history, IP cluster analysis, device fingerprinting, request pattern entropy. Need KYC docs, corporate email verification, and any the sales contact. Also require signed addendum for elevated burst.

henry: product note: if security verifies, we can approve a 48h trial (P1). If risk is medium/high, deny and offer graduated ramp (2x then 3x). tagging @samir for rollout policy. :thumbsup:

rachel: added escalation form into Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REQ-7123. Assignees: nina, samir. Attachments: customer request, logs, payment receipt. Leaving note for sales to prep addendum.

alison: (sales) picked this up — Acme's rep is Sam Lee. I have the pilot MSA; can draft a temporary spike addendum today. Please tag me once security greenlights.

nina: preliminary findings: multiple signups from same billing contact + unusual geo hopping of IPs -> medium risk. No chargebacks yet. Will finish deep review in ~2h. If clear, recommend 2x immediate, escalate product for full 5x.

samir: agreed. implementing temp cap to 800/s starting ts 1770001500. I'll also add request to routing policy to prefer dedicated capacity if they exceed baseline.

rachel: ack — cap set and Jira updated. Closing thread for operational handoff; will post security outcome in the Jira ticket. Thanks all.
